column1: # Expected bindings rows for the js-ts fixture.
# one per line, byte-sorted. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly against
# <out>/bindings.tsv: a missing line is a binding the extractor stopped finding,
# an extra line is one it invented. Both are regressions.
# Written from the fixture sources and the bindings spec alone, by an
# independent oracle that never saw the extractor or its output; the two are
# reconciled separately. `to` is pinned to the edges in EXPECTED.tsv.
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
# - scripts/build.mjs:5 import attributes (with { type: "json" }) are ignored; pkg is a plain default binding.
# - scripts/build.mjs:23,25 import.meta.url is not an import: no row.
# - src/app.tsx:26 multi-line await import( with the specifier on line 27: line is 26, the line holding import(.
# - src/util.ts:3 import util from "util": no EXPECTED.tsv edge (bare builtin; via src/ it would be itself), so to/conf empty.
# - src/esm/native.cts:5 and src/legacy/loader.cjs:19 require.resolve(...): no row, although native.cts->loader.cjs is an edge.
# - src/legacy/loader.cjs:20 return require("./config.cjs") is an unbound require: its own row beside the bound one on line 4.
# - src/lib/index.ts:9 export * from "react": reexport-star row with empty to/conf.
# - src/types/globals.d.ts declare module "..." blocks are declarations, not imports: no rows.

# - alias flag (added with the spec's fourth flag) on src/app.tsx:7, src/app.tsx:8, src/components/Button.tsx:3, src/esm/wrapper.mts:1, src/index.ts:6, src/util.ts:4; alias specifiers that do not resolve (src/esm/wrapper.mts:7, src/util.ts:7) have empty to, so no alias.
